First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bicastucson the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BICAS WTF Ride group ride

A monthly night ride for women, trans and femme riders, run out of the BICAS community bike shop. It grows out of the weekly WTF workshop, which runs Mondays 3–7 pm. The June edition is a Pride ride. All WTF-identifying folks welcome.
